title: Meeting a real recluse on the second Athos trip

tellings.quote: I actually met a real recluse the second time I went to Mount Athos and who gave me a book and tremendous conversation we had about the apocalypse.

plain: A man named Ralph says that on his second trip to Mount Athos in Greece, around 2005, he met a real hermit living apart from the world. He says the hermit gave him a book and that the two had a remarkable conversation about the apocalypse, the end of the world. He tells it as one of the encounters that shaped his unusual spiritual and personal story.
